text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, so employees can focus on more interesting work. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help people save time and work more efficiently. Human-AI collaboration is also becoming common, with workers and machines solving problems together. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, and workers need to learn new skills. Overall, AI offers great opportunities, but it also requires people to adapt and keep learning.
